result.summary: One clear visual defect: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now' shows a broken-image placeholder instead of its hero photo. The rest of the layout (header, search, chips, promo banner, carousel, bottom navigation) renders correctly.

issues.description: The hero image for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in 'Popular right now' failed to load. The card shows a grey box with a generic broken-image icon. It is the most prominent card on screen, so it looks unfinished and reduces appeal compared with the photographed cards around it.
issues.suggestion: Check the image URL, CDN availability and loading logic for this restaurant. Add a graceful fallback, such as a branded cuisine illustration or a skeleton with a retry, instead of the generic broken-image icon.
